content.user_title: Connect Yuanjing AI for Image Workflows
content.value_statement: Desktop agents need account connection and installation checks before using Yuanjing AI. This skill guides setup and delegates authorized image tasks to the installed service skill.
actual_capabilities: Guides retrieval of Yuanjing installation instructions and verification of manifest-provided SHA-256 checksums.
Directs local account authentication while keeping authorization codes out of chat, command arguments, logs, and URLs.
Guides separate checks for connection, full skill installation, host tool loading, and available account capabilities.
Routes user materials and image requirements to the separately installed yuanjing-ai skill after upload authorization and budget confirmation.
Directs recovery of existing timed-out tasks before retrying to reduce duplicate generation charges.
limitations: Requires a compatible local agent that can execute connection programs, protect credentials, and install skills.
Does not include the authentication program, connection program, image engine, or complete yuanjing-ai skill.
Models, features, download permissions, and pricing depend on the connected account and current service availability.
Image generation consumes account compute and requires an exact current quote within a user-approved budget.

use_cases.title: Connect a Design Workstation
use_cases.description: Guide local authentication and verify installation before delegating image editing tasks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Pass approved product photos, visual requirements, and a confirmed budget to the connected image service.

use_cases.title: Recover an Interrupted Image Task
use_cases.description: Check the existing timed-out task and recover available results before starting another paid request.

prompt_templates.title: Check Connection Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this agent can connect to Yuanjing AI. Report prerequisites and current connection status without generating images. Ask before installing or running downloaded programs.

prompt_templates.title: Connect an Account
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me connect Yuanjing AI on this desktop. Verify installation checksums and ask before local execution. Keep authorization codes in local interactive prompts only.

prompt_templates.title: Create Product Image Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Yuanjing AI to make [quantity] product visuals from [materials] with [constraints]. Confirm upload permission, available capabilities, and an exact quote within [budget] first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: delegate an authorized image workflow

prompt_templates.title: Recover a Timed-Out Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate Yuanjing task [task identifier] after its timeout. Check the same task and recover original outputs. Do not create another paid task without approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover results without duplicate charges

best_practices: Review downloaded components and verify release integrity before approving local installation or execution.
Enter authorization codes only in the official local interactive prompt, never in chat or command arguments.
Confirm upload permission and exact generation costs; check existing tasks before retrying after timeouts.
anti_patterns: Running remote authentication programs solely because their checksum matches the same remote manifest.
Sending private materials or starting paid generation without upload authorization and a confirmed budget.
Treating connection checks as completed image generation or retrying timed-out tasks without checking their status.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides connection and delegates image tasks to the separately installed yuanjing-ai skill.

faq.question: Can I use it in a browser-only or hosted agent?
faq.answer: Setup requires local execution, credential protection, and skill installation. Unsupported environments are directed to official instructions for a compatible desktop agent.

faq.question: Where should I enter my authorization code?
faq.answer: Enter it only in the official program's local interactive prompt. Do not paste it into chat, command arguments, logs, or URLs.

faq.question: Will checking my connection generate images?
faq.answer: The instructions separate connection checks from generation. Generation requires a current exact quote within your confirmed budget.

faq.question: Which models and features are available?
faq.answer: The connected service supplies current account capabilities. This connector does not guarantee a fixed model list or feature set.

faq.question: What happens when a generation request times out?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the agent to check the same task and recover original outputs before retrying, reducing duplicate charges.
